violations.description: Hardcoded API credential, token, or secret key committed to source code
violations.evidence: Hardcoded credential assigned in source code: STRIPE_API_KEY = "***REDACTED***"
violations.recommendation: Remove hardcoded secrets from git history and load credentials from environment variables or a secrets manager.

violations.description: CI workflow uses continue-on-error to bypass failed validation gates
violations.evidence: Workflow '.github/workflows/ci.yml' specifies 'continue-on-error: true', allowing test failures or security defects to pass silently.
violations.recommendation: Remove 'continue-on-error: true' from test or critical lint jobs so failures properly block CI pipelines.

violations.description: Potentially dangerous use of pull_request_target with untrusted head checkout
violations.evidence: Workflow '.github/workflows/pr_review.yml' triggers on 'pull_request_target', which can allow arbitrary code execution with repository write tokens.
violations.recommendation: Use standard 'pull_request' trigger or avoid checking out untrusted PR head commit in pull_request_target.

violations.description: Committed local configuration or .env file detected in repository: Committed environment secret file (.env)
violations.evidence: Tracked artifact path in git index: '.env'
violations.recommendation: Add .env and local configuration files to .gitignore and provide a sanitized .env.example instead.

violations.description: Unconstrained or wildcard dependency version specifications detected
violations.recommendation: Pin dependencies to specific or bounded versions (e.g. ~=, ==, >=x,<y) to avoid breaking changes from upstream releases.

violations.description: Missing automated linter or code formatting configuration
violations.evidence: No linting or formatting configuration (ruff.toml, .flake8, pyproject.toml [tool.ruff], eslint) found.
violations.recommendation: Configure an automated linter/formatter (such as Ruff, Flake8, Black, or ESLint) to ensure consistent code quality.

violations.description: CI workflow exists but does not execute automated tests
violations.evidence: Repository contains tests, but CI workflow '.github/workflows/ci.yml' has no test execution step (steps found: ['checkout', 'setup-python', 'build']).
violations.recommendation: Include a testing step (e.g. 'pytest' or 'npm test') in CI workflows to validate every push and pull request.
